reason: The README clearly describes a chat interface plugin that detects existing local image paths in assistant responses and renders them inline with configurable sizing and lightbox viewing.

summaries.zh: 在对话正文中自动渲染助手回复里的本地图片路径，并支持尺寸设置和点击放大查看。
summaries.en: Automatically renders existing local image paths found in assistant replies as inline images with configurable dimensions and click-to-enlarge viewing.

capabilities: Reads local image files after path detection
Serves detected images through a loopback plugin route
Rewrites assistant message content to render local images inline
Provides configurable image display dimensions and lightbox viewing
